findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The sanitizer buckets were tested and recorded at 0ppm at the start of the inspection. The sanitizer buckets were removed from service and remade. The remade sanitizer buckets were tested and recorded at 100ppm chlorine. Ensure that the sanitizer buckets are tested regularly and changed out when needed.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures & records
findings.comment:
3-501.19: Facility has a time as control policy for their food items along the prep line. This time as control is monitored by time records on a magnetic strip. Upon start of inspection, these times had not been updated. When this was brought up to the manager, they immediately corrected the violation. Ensure that time as control records are up to date when the product is placed on the prep line. 
3-501.19: (A) If time without temperature used for public health control, written procedure approved by regulatory authority shall be available upon request (Pf). (B) If time is used as control for up to 4 hours, food shall have initial temperature of 41F (or less) or 135F (or greater). FOOD shall be marked, cooked and served within 4 hour time limit. If FOOD is unmarked or marked exceeding 4-hour limit, FOOD shall be discarded. (P) (C) If time is used as control for up to 6 hours, food shall have initial temperature of 41F or less. FOOD shall not exceed 70F. If FOOD is unmarked or marked exceeding 6-hour limit, FOOD shall be discarded. (D) HSP FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS cannot use time control for raw eggs.

findings.comment:

This cloth was immediately moved and placed inside the bucket of sanitizing solution. Ensure this practice continues for proper storage of the wiping cloth.
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The containers that were air drying on the clean side of the triple dish sink were contaminated by a soiled spatula that was placed next to the containers and had liquid flowing between the two items. The spatula was placed in the correct side of the triple sink and the containers were placed back to go through the dish washing process again. Ensure employees are aware of placing soiled items in the vicinity of the clean items to prevent cross-contamination from occurring.
4-601.11: (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
